title: Burrito Grinch (Ultimatum) Playermodel
description:
[h1]Have you truly become a monster?[/h1]
The dancing Grinch from 1:30 of PilotRedSun's [i]Grinch's Ultimatum[/i]: leather jacket, white tee, yellow-green neck fluff, belt and jeans. Now he's a player model, ready to dance in the park on any map.

[quote][b]The original:[/b]  [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BuKft9LpL_0&t=90s]Grinch's Ultimatum by PilotRedSun (YouTube, 1:30)[/url]
[b]Bugs and ideas:[/b]  [url=https://github.com/StevenNaliwajka/gmod-grinch/issues]github.com/StevenNaliwajka/gmod-grinch/issues[/url][/quote]

[h2]What you get[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]The Grinch as a player model.[/b] Pick [b]Burrito Grinch (Ultimatum)[/b] in the player model menu (C menu > Player Model).
[*][b]The dance.[/b] Type [b]act dance[/b] in console and he does the park dance (that's him in the preview).
[*][b]Every animation works.[/b] He's built on the stock ValveBiped skeleton, bone for bone, so walking, running, sitting, holding guns and every taunt play properly.
[*][b]Green claws in first person.[/b] Matching hands with the jacket cuffs when you hold a weapon.
[*][b]Ragdolls.[/b] He flops like a regular citizen when he dies.
[*][b]Cartoon look.[/b] Flat colours with black outlines, like the video's hand-drawn style.
[*][b]Flame hair, smug eyes and a smirk.[/b] Tall green tufts, half-lidded yellow eyes, orange brows and a pink smirk.
[*][b]Works on servers.[/b] It sends its own files to players, so friends see him too.
[/list]

[h2]How to use[/h2]
[list]
[*]Subscribe.
[*]Hold C, click [b]Player Model[/b], and pick [b]Burrito Grinch (Ultimatum)[/b].
[*]Type [b]act dance[/b] in console and recreate 1:30.
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]One model, no bodygroups or skins (yet).
[*]Fan work, made for fun. The Grinch belongs to Dr. Seuss Enterprises; this design and the animation belong to PilotRedSun. Go watch the original.
[/list]
